questions.question: Clarify the account of Cicero’s identification of Archimedes’ tomb, the attribution of Heron’s formula and the exact wording of quotations; state the Fields Medal age rule precisely.

localizations.source: Clarify the account of Cicero’s identification of Archimedes’ tomb, the attribution of Heron’s formula and the exact wording of quotations; state the Fields Medal age rule precisely.
localizations.ru: Уточнить рассказ Цицерона о гробнице Архимеда, атрибуцию формулы Герона и точность цитат; точно сформулировать возрастное правило Филдсовской премии.

questions.resolution: The tomb episode now names Cicero and uses the defensible interval “more than a century”; the unsupported Heron-formula claim was removed, the lever saying is marked as traditional attribution, and the Fields Medal rule is stated in its official date-based form.

questions.question: Identify the original work and creator of the Archimedes portrait cover, and provide a public source and license or a verified public-domain basis.

localizations.source: Identify the original work and creator of the Archimedes portrait cover, and provide a public source and license or a verified public-domain basis.
localizations.ru: Установить исходное произведение и автора портретной обложки Архимеда, указать публичный источник и лицензию либо подтверждённое основание общественного достояния.

questions.question: Reconcile the original publication date: the article records 31 August 2023, while the package description records 29 August 2023.

localizations.source: Reconcile the original publication date: the article records 31 August 2023, while the package description records 29 August 2023.
localizations.ru: Сверить исходную дату публикации: в статье указано 31.08.2023, а описание пакета содержит 29.08.2023.
